assumptions.text: Freelance graphic designers in Egypt and the MENA region need a way to track client projects, invoices sent, and revision rounds.
assumptions.cheapest_test: Survey 10 freelance designers in Egypt and the MENA region to understand their current workflow and whether they need a tool for tracking.

assumptions.text: There is no clear evidence of willingness to pay for a bilingual template pack priced at USD 100.
assumptions.cheapest_test: Create a landing page with a one-time purchase link and track how many clicks and sign-ups occur within a week.

assumptions.text: A custom Notion Templates - Upwork is priced at USD 100.
assumptions.cheapest_test: Search for pricing information on Upwork and verify the price of a custom Notion Templates.

assumptions.text: Sync2Sheets offers a 7-day free trial with no credit card required.
assumptions.cheapest_test: Visit the Sync2Sheets website and check the pricing and trial options.

assumptions.text: Freelance graphic designers in Egypt and the MENA region will prefer a bilingual (Arabic and English) template pack over one that is only in English.
assumptions.cheapest_test: Create two versions of the template pack—one in Arabic and one in English—and ask 10 freelance designers in Egypt and the MENA region to choose their preferred version.

assumptions.text: Freelance graphic designers in Egypt and the MENA region will not collect client data when using the template pack.
assumptions.cheapest_test: Survey 10 freelance designers in Egypt and the MENA region to understand their data privacy concerns and whether they would use a template pack that does not collect client data.
